UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: User profile containing authenticated identity details

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the account owner

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the user account profile was created

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the user account profile was last updated

LessonDeck.title: LessonDeck
LessonDeck.description: Vocabulary card list and metadata for a specific lesson number

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the deck owner

title.description: Custom title or topic description for the lesson

words.description: List of flashcard word objects belonging to this lesson

StudyProgress.title: StudyProgress
StudyProgress.description: Spaced repetition state, completed days, favorites, weak words, and study metrics

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the progress owner

completedDays.description: Map of day index to completion flag

completedDayLessons.description: Map of composite day_lesson key to completion flag

completedDaysDates.description: Map of day index to completion date string

lessonTitles.description: Map of lesson indices to custom titles

autoSpeak5Sec.description: Whether to auto-speak words after 5 seconds

dailyLearnedWords.description: Log of unique learned words per date

weakWords.description: Map of weak words to mistake counters

hints.description: Map of custom word hints and mnemonics

updatedAt.description: Timestamp of the last progress sync

TestConnection.title: TestConnection
TestConnection.description: Simple document used to verify Firestore connectivity on app boot

/users/{userId}.description: Individual user profile information with strict owner-only access

/users/{userId}/decks/{deckId}.description: Custom flashcard decks belonging to a user

/users/{userId}/progress/main.description: User spaced repetition study progress and mastery settings

/test/{testId}.description: Test document for startup connectivity verification
